mapper.update: update tasks set title = #{task.title}, description = #{task.description}, notes = #{task.notes}, updated_at = #{task.updatedAt}, status = #{task.status}, priority = #{task.priority}, due_date = #{task.dueDate}, reminder_date = #{task.reminderDate} where id = #{task.id}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, title, description, notes, created_at, updated_at, status, priority, due_date, reminder_date from tasks where id = #{id}
select id, user_id, title, description, notes, created_at, updated_at, status, priority, due_date, reminder_date from tasks where title = #{title} limit 1
